title: Retail
description: Lumen Retail Group, a fictional omnichannel home-and-lifestyle retailer with 24 stores in four US regions plus Lumen.com: stores, products, customers, orders and returns for April 2025 to September 2026 beside its return policy, store operations SOP, supplier terms, a scanned loss-prevention memo and its Q3 2026 performance reports.
disclaimer: Synthetic data for a software demonstration: Lumen Retail Group and every store, product, customer, supplier, document and figure are fictional, and any resemblance to a real company or person is coincidental.

questions.label: Return windows and restocking fees
questions.description: Read the restocking fee table in the return policy PDF.
questions.question: What return window and restocking fee apply to electronics and to furniture under Lumen's return policy, and are defective items charged the fee?

questions.label: No-receipt return limits
questions.description: The answer is in a scanned memo, which only a vision parser can read.
questions.question: What does the loss-prevention memo set as the maximum value of a no-receipt return, how many no-receipt returns can one customer make in 90 days, and what is the lower limit at stores on enhanced monitoring?

questions.label: Fastest-growing region in Q3
questions.description: Find the regional table in the Q3 2026 performance report PDF.
questions.question: According to the Q3 2026 regional performance report, which region grew net sales fastest year over year, and what were its Q3 2026 net sales?

questions.label: Top stores by Q3 net sales
questions.description: Rank physical stores by net sales for the last full quarter.
questions.question: Which five physical stores (excluding the online store) had the highest net sales in Q3 2026, July 1 to September 30?

questions.label: Categories against plan
questions.description: Join the planning workbook's targets to order lines.
questions.question: Which product categories missed their Q3 2026 net sales target in the merchandising plan, and by what percentage?

questions.label: Highest return rate by category
questions.description: Returned value as a share of net sales, by product category.
questions.question: Which product category had the highest return rate in Q3 2026, measured as the value of items returned in the quarter divided by net sales in the quarter?

questions.label: Electronics returns and restocking fee
questions.description: Count returns in the tables, then apply the policy's restocking fee.
questions.question: Which physical store processed the most electronics returns in Q3 2026, and under the return policy how much restocking fee would be due on that store's opened, non-defective electronics returns?

questions.label: Stores on enhanced return monitoring
questions.description: Read the store list from the scanned memo, then total their returns in the tables.
questions.question: The loss-prevention memo puts three stores on enhanced return monitoring. How many returns did those stores process in Q3 2026, and what share of the chain's returned value is that?
